deviations.edit: Test-only helper insertPgScan() wraps the raw public.scans INSERT in ALTER TABLE ... DISABLE/ENABLE TRIGGER ALL to avoid a tiger.state AccessExclusiveLock deadlock in the RefreshDatabase harness (HasZodDatabase adds a tiger.state column on the zod conn, holding a lock the scans BEFORE-INSERT trigger would block on). Fixture-only; no triggers needed for this fixture; no change to code under test.
RN2 fix: relabel discriminator TransportExceptionInterface->mail_failed else build_failed (+2 tests). Fixes lane1 Medium.

Prod-scale EXPLAIN(ANALYZE) showed the MATERIALIZED-CTE alone is ~38.9s for shift 22 (127,318 scans over a 7-day window) — still over the ~30s prod timeout; dominant cost is reading 127k scan geometries, not the plan or the spatial join. Root cause reframed as shift-lifecycle (no max-shift-duration cap). Dalton chose: keep the CTE (defensive; fast for normal shifts + prevents the zones-driven bad plan) and rely on DEV-2309 upstream to restore timely shift closing. No additional DEV-2325 code.
deviations.ac_delta: SATISFIED → PARTIAL/upstream-dependent (AC-1 now satisfied for normal shifts by the CTE + for the pathological case by DEV-2309, not by DEV-2325 alone)

findings_fixed: Medium (AC-3, lane1@RN1): SendEndOfShiftSummary::failed() keyed the skip reason on QueryException, mislabeling ClickHouse-origin build failures (miles/scans/hits reads before Mail::send) as mail_failed. Fixed: label mail_failed only for a Symfony TransportExceptionInterface, build_failed otherwise (PG 57014 + CH outages -> build_failed). Added tests: non-mail/CH build failure -> build_failed; and a hidden (is_visible=false) in-zone scan pinning that the raw-SQL breakdown counts hidden scans (no ShowVisibleScan filter).
findings_residual: Non-scoring, PRE-EXISTING (not worsened by this diff), candidate follow-up: EndOfShiftSummary implements ShouldQueue, so Mail::to(...)->send() enqueues a separate SendQueuedMailable job; the actual SMTP transport (and any TransportExceptionInterface) happens in THAT job, so a true delivery failure never reaches SendEndOfShiftSummary::failed(), and summary_sent_at is stamped at enqueue time. mail_failed is largely unreachable in prod; build failures (the DEV-2325 incident) are the reachable path and are now correctly labeled.

Non-scoring, pre-existing: handle() holds the kit_shifts lockForUpdate across the whole build (CH reads + PG query + mail enqueue); long lock-hold, now harmless since the query is fast. Optional follow-up (needs a claim/CAS to narrow safely — idempotency).

Out of scope (follow-up ticket candidate): app/Filament/Client/Resources/ClientSearchScansResource.php:92 has the same-family unfenced Scan::query()->forOrg() carrying the ScanTimezoneScope join; no prod evidence in DEV-2325.

ac.item: AC-1: SendEndOfShiftSummary completes without SQLSTATE[57014] (verify post-deploy in laravel.log)
ac.evidence: Confirmed from the prod log: the 57014 statement was an EXACT match for buildZoneSummaries (scans⋈zones ST_Contains), stack-traced through SendEndOfShiftSummary:87→forShift(); shift 22 spanned Aug 3→Aug 10 (~7 days). Prod-scale EXPLAIN(ANALYZE) of the MATERIALIZED-CTE fix on the real params (kit 14928/org 2575, 7-day window, 127,318 scans): ~38.9s exec, ~33s of it I/O reading the 127k scan geometries (zones GiST probe only 0.04ms/row) — so the CTE bounds the PLAN but NOT the VOLUME; it would STILL 57014 (~30s prod timeout) for this shift. DECISION (Dalton): the 7-day shift is a shift-lifecycle problem (no max-duration cap; CloseInactiveShiftsCommand closes only on ≥3h inactivity), whose root fix is upstream DEV-2309 (restores timely closing → normal hours-long shifts → the CTE query is fast). So AC-1 holds for NORMAL shifts via the CTE, and for the pathological case via DEV-2309 — NOT by DEV-2325 alone. Residual edge: a genuinely always-on kit (never a ≥3h gap) still lacks a hard cap; accepted.

ac.item: AC-2: the timing-out query in the summary path is bounded/optimized
ac.evidence: Full agent-qa backend lane (dev env + real Docker CH + PostGIS): seeded shift+zone+3 scans, ran forShift() live → zones=1 (outside excluded), 2 scans counted incl. the hidden one (ShowVisibleScan bypass holds), runtime SQL carries the shift_scans MATERIALIZED CTE; clean log tail. Also pinned by 14 tests + EXPLAIN.

ac.item: AC-3: retry-exhaustion no longer silently drops a summary — records a skip reason
